notes: «وروى بعضهم» is a gap: an unnamed transmitter.
«قال أبو بكر وهذا أصح» and «قال أبو بكر فذكر نحوه» are the compiler's comments on the chain, not links; the speaker's identity is not decided here.
The second isnad carries the same saying in other words (no mention of Abu Sa'id); it is a second route, not a variant.
